l.i: Neoburgi vel Nevvenburgi Comes ad Danubium.

main_text.l: Neonari vel Nevvenari, id est Nova Aquila Comes.
Obersteini Comes in Alsatia. Forte, Ebersteini.
main_text.p: Ortenburgi Comes in Bavaria, qui nunc dicuntur Antiquiores Comites de Ortenburg, respectu eorum qui à Carolo V. Imp. creati sub Austriacis degunt, sed inter Ordinos liberos & Comitiales non computantur.

l.i: Phirreti Comes, qui & Ferraria, in Alsatia.

main_text.l: Radenbachi Comes. Forte infra inter Barones, Radenach.
Remontÿ vel Romuntÿ, id est Rotundimontis Comes in Sabaudia.

l.i: Rotenburgi Comes ad Rufam in Helvetia.
Rotenburgi Comes ad Nicrum in Suevia.

page.notes: Faint foot mark "(***)" beside the signature "Schlick" at the bottom, not transcribed as text. Some words in the running index are partly obscured by stains (e.g. "Ochsensteini", "Octinge", "Raprechtsvvileri", "Rutschenfordia" are uncertain readings).
